constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

claims.text: Animate the supplied photo with slow drifting motion.
The supplied image is a character reference sheet dominated by a rainy nighttime hero image of a dark-clad figure on a wet elevated walkway with metal railings and blurred amber city lights.
The figure has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot, and wears a black collared jacket, dark shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
Slow rain streaks, breath vapor, beaded droplets, and ambient rain and city-traffic sound are added to animate the still image in a restrained way.

subjects.description: A grounded adult figure with short dark hair shaved at the sides and gathered into a small topknot at the back, a neutral serious face, and an all-dark tactical wardrobe: black collared jacket with straps and dark hardware, dark crew-neck shirt, black cargo trousers, and worn black lace-up combat boots.
subjects.retention_details: Preserve the face, undercut hairstyle, topknot, and all-dark jacket, shirt, cargo trousers, and combat boots; do not reproduce the reference-sheet panel layout, labels, or studio backdrop.

description.text: In a medium-wide composition, cold blue-gray ambient light rakes across a rain-soaked elevated walkway. Metal railings run along both sides, beaded with water, while warm amber city bokeh trembles far behind them through curtains of rain.

stands upright and nearly motionless near the center, boots planted on slick concrete. The black collared jacket, dark shirt, and cargo trousers hold a desaturated charcoal weight against the wet reflections; the shaved sides and small topknot catch a faint rim light. Shoulders lift slightly with a breath, rain streaks cross the frame at a constant slant, and puddles mirror the distant lights. The atmosphere feels grounded and gritty, with shallow depth of field and subtle grain softening the background.

The head turns slightly, then the gaze settles; a blink and a slow exhalation send a faint breath plume into the chilled air. Droplets bead along the jaw, the jacket collar, and the straps and dark hardware at the chest. Metal railings glisten behind the shoulder, and warm amber city lights break into soft bokeh through the falling rain. The palette stays black, charcoal, cool blue-gray, and muted teal, with only the amber highlights warming the distance. Wet fabric catches a narrow sheen, while shallow focus and film grain keep the image intimate and photorealistic.

style: Photorealistic gritty cinematic look, desaturated black and charcoal wardrobe with cool blue-gray ambient light, warm amber city bokeh, visible rain streaks and wet-surface reflections, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain.
